preToolUse.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m devgent hook pre

postToolUse.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m devgent hook post

postToolUseFailure.bash: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/hooks" python3 -m devgent hook post-failure
